title: Photoelectrochemical Reduction of Carbon Dioxide on Quantum-Dot-Modified Electrodes by Electric Field Directed Layer-by-Layer Assembly Methodology

source_inventory.title: Photoelectrochemical Reduction of Carbon Dioxide on Quantum-Dot-Modified Electrodes by Electric Field Directed Layer-by-Layer Assembly Methodology
source_inventory.scope: The author and independent auditor each read all five main and four SI pages as text and original-page images: two CdTe–MSA reflux classes, ITO cleaning, PDDA and PMAEMA electrode assemblies, structural and optical measurements, polymer-only and ITO controls, LSV and dark/light CO2 electrolysis contexts. External cited full recipes and unprinted numerical plot values remain excluded.
source_conflicts: The main p.4 synthesis cites reference 21, which is Gao et al. EFDLA in the main reference list, while main p.2 and SI cite the Díaz et al. CdTe–thiol paper. No external recipe is imported or substituted for the locally printed procedure.

The main p.4 Methods list alternating immersion in 0.0756 mM polycation solutions and 0.5 M NaCl, whereas the labels and source schematic describe polycation/QD layers. The QD bath composition/concentration, NaCl bath assignment and exact immersion sequence are not fully specified; no bath recipe is silently repaired.

Main PDF p.2 reports ITO-(PMAEMA/QDs)6 height 183.5 nm and roughness 27.7 nm. SI PDF p.3 Table S2 reports height 158.9 ± 21.8 nm and roughness 20.6 ± 5.5 nm. Both contexts are retained without choosing one or asserting different measured batches.
Figure S2 is captioned j–E, but its ordinate is current i in µA. Main Figure 3 shows j in µA/cm²; no area or conversion between those ordinates is inferred.
limitations: No inferred physical batch identity among source-associated samples.
No raw curve digitization, measured atomic coordinates or training eligibility.
Source figure reuse permission remains unverified.
